summary: Heavily obfuscated index.js with no traced behavior
details: The package's index.js is heavily obfuscated, exhibiting classic string-array shuffling patterns (while(!![]), repeated ['shift']() calls, and large hex constants) that hide the real control flow and string contents from inspection. Obfuscation of this kind is uncommon for legitimate utility libraries and is frequently used to conceal credential theft, exfiltration, or remote loading, but the underlying behavior was not traced and no concrete installer-harm primitive (network exfil, credential read, lifecycle hook, dropper) was confirmed. The package name suggests a small array/iteration helper, which has no plausible reason to ship obfuscated code.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
